# Yeeflow 1.16.2

Branding patch based on stable 1.16.1.

- Display name: **Yeeflow**. Descriptions and starter prompts cover business data, tasks, application building and authorized administration.
- Active logo and composer icon use the existing official blue Yeeflow symbol, byte for byte. Release preparation restores these assets from the approved bundled source.
- Technical plugin ID `yeeflow-app-builder`, marketplace ID `yeeflow`, four MCP services, authentication settings and all 27 skills remain unchanged.
- Both Codex and ChatGPT Web profiles inherit the same public branding. Web registered App mappings remain explicit deployment inputs.

This release does not submit the plugin for public ChatGPT review, expand permissions or claim new runtime acceptance. Public submission remains pending user confirmation.
